marks.label: Enter the atlas
marks.sub: Every star is a genre, grouped into eight families.

marks.label: Orbit
marks.sub: Drag to turn the whole map in 3D.

marks.label: Fly to a genre
marks.sub: Search or click a star: the camera flies there and the panel explains it.

marks.label: Read it
marks.sub: What makes it unique, its signature sound, and its history.

marks.label: Hear the building blocks
marks.sub: A synthesized loop of the genre’s rhythm, bass and signature effect.

marks.label: Follow a connection
marks.sub: Related genres link into constellations; jump along them.

marks.label: Back out
marks.sub: Zoom back to the whole atlas.
